### Taken to Pilate
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/taken-pilate
Passage: Mark 15:1-5
Points:
- Under Roman rule, the Sanhedrin lacked the authority to inflict capital punishment, prompting them to send Jesus to Pontius Pilate early in the morning.
- To secure a Roman death sentence, the religious leaders reframed their religious charge of blasphemy into a political charge of sedition against Caesar.
- Although Jesus affirmed His true kingship, He astonished Pilate by refusing to answer the barrage of false accusations.
- Christ willingly stood accused as a criminal before a human governor so that His people could be acquitted in the divine court.
- By bearing our condemnation and giving us His righteousness, Jesus enables believers to stand before their Creator unafraid.
